clearedSpotChecks.note: Fetched statedb.go from OffchainLabs/go-ethereum master: line 1599 sets s.transientStorage = newTransientStorage() at the end of Prepare, outside the IsEIP2929 branch, so it runs unconditionally. Fetched core/state_transition.go: line 736 calls st.state.Prepare in the per-message execute path, so every message, including Arbitrum retryable redeems that run as their own transactions, starts with empty transient storage. The other writers of transientStorage are the constructor (line 201), Set (626) and Copy (781), none of which carries state across transactions. Lock and NonzeroDeltaCount read and write only through tload and tstore (src/libraries/Lock.sol:13-25, src/libraries/NonzeroDeltaCount.sol:14-32), so an unlocked flag or delta count left by one transaction cannot be seen by the next.
